newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar and stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar and stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against both dollar and sterling on Monday, reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 20.4115 to the dollar, from 20.4865 on last Friday, and at a commercial mean rate of 33.4635 to the sterling, from 33.6225 on Friday.

Forex dealers said the central bank sold dollars on the interbank forex market on Friday at the prevailing interbank rate. They added that some commercial banks were slightly short in hard currency on Monday.
